info.title: ARENA API
info.description: API documentation for the ARENA application.

BearerAuth.description: Login endpoint'inden token alıp buraya yapıştır. Korumalı endpoint'ler için gerekli.

post.summary: Register new user and issue JWT

post.description: Creates a new organization with the authenticated user as the owner (SUPER_ADMIN)

get.summary: Get all organizations for the authenticated user
get.description: Returns all organizations where the user is a member
Public endpoint to fetch organization details by subdomain (for routing)

delete.description: Delete organization and all related data (owner only, cascade delete)

post.description: Creates a new quiz in the specified organization. Requires MANAGER role or higher.

get.description: Lists all active quizzes for the organization. Ordered by creation date descending.

get.summary: Get quiz by ID with questions
get.description: Retrieves detailed quiz information including all questions ordered by index.

patch.description: Updates quiz title or default mode. Only provided fields are updated.

delete.description: Soft deletes a quiz by setting isDeleted=true. Questions remain in DB.

patch.description: Update question details. If options provided, must be exactly 4.

delete.description: Delete a question from the quiz

get.description: Returns a single question with hierarchy validation

post.description: Creates a new question for the quiz. Must have exactly 4 options.

get.summary: Get all questions for a quiz
get.description: Returns all questions sorted by orderIndex (ASC)
